title: Roam Daily Notes Weekly Output Trend
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roam:daily
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(daily_note_words) as total_output avg(daily_note_words) as avg_output by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks weekly daily note words for roam daily notes so bursts and dry spells are easy to spot.
value: Knowledge work often feels fuzzy, and a simple output trend gives it a visible rhythm without overcomplicating things.
implementation: Choose a single primary metric per source, such as new notes, words, tasks completed, or notes reviewed.
visualization: Line chart of weekly total and average daily note words.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how much roam daily notes output you are producing week by week.
